opening.argument: The video presents a recognizable customer-service software product, identifying Buffer Reply as a tool previously known as Respond and inviting viewers to try it. Its described functions are operational rather than financial: a real-time tweet inbox, custom searches, and team collaboration for assigning and managing conversations. The sampled interface supports that ordinary product presentation, showing a scheduling control with a Save button and a search for “social media tips.” Nothing in the described offer involves investment returns, payment solicitation, credential collection, or financial participation. Requests to subscribe to the channel and follow Buffer accounts are ordinary audience-engagement actions, not conditions attached to a financial or data-related offer.

citations.quote: Be among the first to try our brand new customer service tool, Buffer Reply (previously known as Respond).
Real-time tweet inbox - Custom searches - Team collaboration: Signatures, double-reply prevention, assign conversations
